items.description: Exactly one subject kind, as ActionPolicyBinding's subject is written.

sandbox.description: One Sandbox in the binding's namespace, by name.

serviceAccount.description: One ServiceAccount in the proxy's namespace, by name: a workload no Sandbox owns, such as a Deployment. Not lifecycle-bound the way a Sandbox subject is -- every Pod running as it is this subject -- so bind only a ServiceAccount dedicated to one workload.

policies.description: EgressPolicy names in the binding's namespace.

expiresAt.description: After this instant the binding contributes nothing.
